description: MINZAL crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/c. Reported CIF formula moiety: C70 H102 Cl1 La3 O12,C4 H10 O1. From the CIF bond table, La1 (La) has 5 O neighbors; La2 (La) has 5 O neighbors; La3 (La) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.432-4.492 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 119.71-120.77°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C70H102ClLa3O12·C4H10O.
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review.
